The '''Tark family estate''' was the home of [[Lanaxa Tark]] and [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Boes Tark]]. They raised their [[Reproduction/Legends|son]] [[Moxin Tark|Moxin]] on the estate before he ran away at age eighteen.
